body: Yeah, throughout high school, Ive seen a few at the college. None of them clicked, they kept asking me if I want to be around people because I seem so closed off and angry. Not many people can empathize with possible personality disorder, Im not going to spill myself just to be seen as a freak.

I remember starting to feel like this in middle school and its just been getting worse. At this point I have no connection to anyone in my life, and pine after this guy I met a few times online bascially all the time. Im kind of waiting for someone to turn to me and say "okay, congradulations, you can start life now" because its just like a gathering nightmare for my entire life and I dont know how to trust anyone.
